method: Every complete final browser PNG was actually opened with tools.view_image during the sole original Node/Playwright host run. No second browser controller, image editing or state-only substitute was used.

images.observation: Full stadium fits auxiliary desktop viewport. Open central field reveals the neutral preview ground, stepped pale stand halves and red-brick perimeter remain distinct, west gate and local dark canopy are visible; no full-ring roof or field slab appears.
Actual LOD state retains open field, continuous stepped stand silhouette, red-brick exterior, west gate and local canopy. Detail reduction is visible without closing the field.

390px auxiliary mobile view contains the whole stand ring above the information panel. Controls including field view and all four downloads remain readable without horizontal overflow; small-scale detail is left to dedicated main-map closeups.

Default main-map desktop view contains the complete stadium stand envelope in the central safe area, with surrounding roads, separate gym/pool sources and buildings retained. The interior is not filled by a stadium solid; several separately identified coarse-map structures remain inside it as required by the mapping contract. The selected name sign covers part of the central field; this whole-model view is not the dedicated aperture proof. Both navigation count indicators show78.

Actual full near view shows stepped stand halves around an unfilled interior and the local west canopy. Independently preserved coarse-map interior structures remain visible; they are not authored stadium solids. The selected beacon covers a small central patch; the south field probe region is visibly open. The large oval extends beyond part of this deliberate near crop, and the default view separately proves whole-model framing.

West close view clearly separates the three outer arch openings, deep pale floors/side reveals and dark rear metal gates. These are bounded recesses rather than straight through-passages. Four tower blocks, narrow windows, bracket/eave bands, urn-like corner ornaments and the local canopy are visible. The selected sign covers part of the upper central panel, not the recessed openings.

South short-end close view shows a central rectangular opening below the lintel with the pale ground lane continuing inside, separate inner side reveals, and two smaller dark side arches. No authored ground-level panel closes the central route. The retained narrow coarse-map structure behind/right remains independent and is not stadium geometry. This view complements the separate static and live collision probes rather than certifying public walking access.

390px default main-map view contains the complete stand oval between the top controls and lower location card, with no horizontal overflow. The title wraps within its card, the78-entry legend is visible, and the selected sign stays readable over the centre. Coarse independent interior structures and neighboring sources remain as expected; this distant whole-field view is supplemented by dedicated full-detail captures.

320x568 city view shows all78 number signs in separate cells, including78, with readable12px text and no visible glyph clipping. Existing22x18 compact signs fit this free area and remain separate from the real Green Tile City Hall card, legend and map tools.

320x548 city view uses the new20x18 compact signs. All78 numbers remain individually readable, including two-digit78, with no visible digit or border collision. The real Green Tile City Hall card remains selected; reducing the viewport reproduces the worst measured current title free area without pretending that the longest-title model was selected.

actualPageNearGroups.note: Actual near-group owners and source HTTP bytes are checked against independent frozen mapping. Group-wide texture binding is not a claim that every owner is individually clipped.

loadedStatusText.explanation: The production models status compares loaded records against all landmark records, including far-away models not requested. It does not prove a current queue is pending. Dedicated images separately bind target loaded status, zero far/near/pending queues and actual stable render frames.

limits: The whole-stadium default views may use the distant asset; dedicated field, west-entry and south-passage views require the full asset.
Independent coarse-map buildings inside or around the field remain visible. The stadium model does not include them or claim the historical field is entirely cleared.
The 192-row figure is the frozen global static clip budget. Actual active and per-owner near-group row counts are recorded per screenshot.
Geometry heights, hidden detail and gate compass assignment remain estimated or photo-context inferred as documented; the browser checks do not create survey evidence.
